message: The imported 49 Earth and 2 Mars terrain records are traceable to the approved NASA Earthdata and PDS products listed below. This terrain-only result is not final challenge evidence and does not verify climate, geology, radiation, landing safety or environmental equivalence.

dataset.inventory_basis: Pinned Git tree inventory verified on 2026-11-15; the repository build script documents the NASADEM Earthdata search and MOLA PDS processing path.

earth_elevation.dataset_name: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001
earth_elevation.provider: NASA JPL / NASA EOSDIS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center
earth_elevation.processing_step: The pinned source build searches NASA Earthdata for NASADEM_HGT version 001 tiles, reads the 3601 x 3601 big-endian HGT grids, merges adjacent tiles, reprojects to a local azimuthal-equidistant metric CRS, resamples to a 5 x 5 grid comparable to the MOLA patch, and computes median slope, elevation standard deviation and P90-P10 relief.
earth_elevation.coverage_and_resolution: Global land coverage at 1 arc-second posting, approximately 30 m; each candidate uses a local 5 x 5 MOLA-comparable terrain patch.
quality_flags: The pinned snapshot contains 150 NASADEM HGT tiles and 150 ZIP caches.
The imported artifact has 49 Earth records and every record has slope, roughness and relief.
Earth elevation is retained as context and is not compared directly with Mars elevation because planetary datums differ.
Terrain-only evidence; climate, geology, radiation, atmosphere and landing safety are not inferred.

mars_elevation.dataset_name: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA MEGDR Topography
mars_elevation.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
mars_elevation.processing_step: The pinned source build validates the MOLA label and binary size, reads the big-endian 16-bit MEGDR image, extracts 5 x 5 patches at Jezero Crater and Olympus Mons flank, and computes median slope, elevation standard deviation and P90-P10 relief.
mars_elevation.coverage_and_resolution: Global Mars topography at 4 pixels per degree; the source build uses the MOLA MEGDR image and its label.
quality_flags: The pinned snapshot contains one MOLA image and one MOLA label.
The imported artifact has two Mars target records and every record has slope, roughness and relief.
Terrain-only evidence; climate, geology, radiation, atmosphere and landing safety are not inferred.

method.guardrail: A terrain similarity score is not final challenge evidence, a landing-site safety assessment, a climate match, a geology match, a radiation assessment or an environmental equivalence claim.
